description.narrative: The Catalyzing Economic Growth for Women project (2025-2027) implemented by UN Women in Pakistan, aims to promote the social and economic empowerment of women in 8 Districts across Punjab, Singh, Balochistan, and Gilgit-Baltistan. Targeting 7,000 women – particularly home-based workers, micro-entrepreneurs, and vulnerable groups including women with disabilities – the project focuses on three strategic outcomes: transitioning women informal workers to the formal sector through improved access to resources, skills, and the implementation of pro-women laws and policies; increasing women’s participation in digital economy by equipping them with digital literacy, e-commerce, and entrepreneurship skills; and influencing policies to enhance women and girls’ economic leadership and resilience by building partnerships with government, private sector, and civil society. Together, these outcomes aim to create an inclusive and enabling environment where women can access decent work, assert their economic rights, and contribute meaningfully to sustainable development in Pakistan.
